compiled_state.title: ci: test_plugin_json_agents_in_sync fails -> version-bump PRs blocked
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

The test test_plugin_json_agents_in_sync fails because plugin.json agents list is out of sync with the agents/ directory. This blocks version-bump PRs (observed on PRs #373, #376). Pre-existing infrastructure issue.

**Impact**: Version-bump PRs fail Script Tests check

comments.body: Classification: mechanical (plugin.json out of sync with agents/ directory). Routing to Mechanical Fix Path.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Investigation: plugin.json agents list is currently IN SYNC with agents/ directory on both this branch and main. The test failures on PRs #373 and #376 were likely transient — caused by a commit that added/removed an agent without updating plugin.json, then fixed by a subsequent commit. No fix needed at this time. If it recurs, a pre-commit hook to auto-sync plugin.json would prevent it.
comments.author: Test
